name: Judging False Teachers
overview: Scripture instructs believers to exercise careful and righteous judgment, avoiding superficial assessments while discerning false teachers who appear harmless but are spiritually dangerous. Jesus warns to beware of those who come in sheep's clothing but are inwardly ravenous wolves, and teaches that true character is revealed by their fruits. The apostle Paul further urges believers to mark and avoid those who cause division and contradict sound doctrine, and to have no fellowship with the unfruitful works of darkness, but rather to reprove them. Thus, judging false teachers involves vigilant evaluation rooted in biblical truth and a commitment to uphold and protect the purity of the gospel.
